fields.value: Cognitive and Noncognitive Skills GWAS summary statistics - excluding NTR, 23andMe and UKBiobank siblings, adoptees and related individuals

dsDescriptionValue.value:
Summary statistics of GWAS of cognitive and noncognitve skills as created and used in Demange et al. 2022 "Estimating effects of parents’ cognitive and non-cognitive skills on offspring education using polygenic scores".

If summary statistics are used, please make sure to include a reference to the original manuscript.

For the original summary statistics of Cog and NonCog, including NTR and UKBiobank siblings data, see Demange, P.A., Malanchini, M., Mallard, T.T. et al. Investigating the genetic architecture of noncognitive skills using GWAS-by-subtraction. Nat Genet 53, 35–44 (2021). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-020-00754-2

publicationCitation.value: Demange, P. A., Hottenga, J. J., Abdellaoui, A., Eilertsen, E. M., Malanchini, M., Domingue, B. W., Zeeuw, E. L. de, Rimfeld, K., Eley, T. C., Boomsma, D. I., Bergen, E. van, Breen, G., Nivard, M. G., & Cheesman, R. (2021). Estimating effects of parents’ cognitive and non-cognitive skills on offspring education using polygenic scores (p. 2020.09.15.296236). bioRxiv. https://doi.org/10.1101/2020.09.15.296236

fields.value:
NonCog_GWAS: GWAS-by-subtraction of non-cognitive aspects of educational attainment. Compared to Demange et al. 2021 the GWAS is excluding NTR and 23andMe participants, and UKBiobank siblings, adoptees and related individuals
Cog_GWAS: GWAS-by-subtraction of cognitive aspects of educational attainment. Compared to Demange et al. 2021 the GWAS is excluding NTR participants and 23andMe participants, and UKBiobank siblings, adoptees and related individuals.

Columns Names:
SNP: SNP rs number
CHR: chromosome number
BP: base pair position
A1: effect allele
A2: other allele
MAF: minor allele frequency in 1000 Genomes Phase 3
Beta: effect of the A1 allele	
SE: standard error of Beta
Z: Z-statistic
P: p-value. 

The effective sample sizes were estimated to:
NonCog N = 458211
Cog N = 223819
